```python
import re

def is_valid_email(email: str) -> bool:
    pattern = r"^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$"
    return bool(re.match(pattern, email))
```

Test it: `is_valid_email("<email>")` → `True`.

Note: this catches format errors, not real-world validity (that requires sending a confirmation email). Want the stricter RFC 5322 version instead?
